scenes.name: Edit schedule
scenes.desc: Hover Julian Andrews' Orion Release Readiness allocation (8h/day, Oct 19 to 23) and open Edit allocation from its card. Select Edit Schedule, pick Thu 22 and Fri 23, set 4h/day and Save changes. The allocation splits into 8h/day for 3 days and 4h/day for 2 days, and Julian's week shows Full Mon to Wed and 4h free Thu to Fri.
